Liudmila Dmitrievna Samsonova (Russian: Людмила Дмитриевна Самсонова , IPA: [lʲʊdˈmʲiɫə sɐmˈsonəvə] ; born 11 November 1998) is a Russian professional tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of No. 12 in singles and No. 36 in doubles. [ 3 ] She has won five singles and two doubles titles on the WTA Tour , her first title being a WTA 500 title at the 2021 German Open . She has also won a total of eight singles [ 4 ] and three doubles [ 5 ] titles on the ITF Circuit .
